input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted § 7.2 because it is a reverse most-favoured-nation obligation requiring us to disclose and match third-party offers for Vendor's benefit; our playbook does not accept MFN obligations running against the customer, and this also conflicts with the no-most-favoured-customer acknowledgement in § 12.3. If Vendor needs something here, we could consider an MFN limited to a single defined product for 12 months with reasonable-comparison carve-outs.
input.summary: Delete reverse MFN obligation on Customer in § 7.2.
